channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Security of Scottish islands questioned in Parliament
item.description: Ministers were pressed in the Commons to clarify whether the government is reassessing the strategic significance of Shetland and surrounding waters, amid heightened Russian maritime activity and a renewed focus on the High North. The post Security of Scottish islands questioned in Parliament first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Strike action resumes at BAE Systems sites in Lancashire
item.description: Strike action has resumed at key BAE Systems facilities in Lancashire after negotiations between the company and Unite the union failed to produce an agreement on pay and conditions. The post Strike action resumes at BAE Systems sites in Lancashire first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK revokes accreditation of a Russian diplomat.
item.description: The UK has summoned the Russian ambassador and revoked the accreditation of a Russian diplomat in response to Moscow’s recent expulsion of a British diplomat, the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office has said. The post UK revokes accreditation of a Russian diplomat. first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain to lead new NATO special ops force
item.description: The UK is preparing to assume leadership of the NATO Allied Reaction Force (ARF) Special Operations Component after completing a two-year programme of preparation, training and validation. The post Britain to lead new NATO special ops force first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rules out funding Scottish steel for new support ships
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed it will not directly fund the supply of steel slabs from British Steel Scunthorpe plant to Liberty Steel Dalzell works for use on the new Fleet Solid Support ships, placing responsibility for sourcing materials firmly with the prime contractor. The post UK rules out funding Scottish steel for new support ships first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Kongsberg Maritime set to spin off as independent company
item.description: Kongsberg Maritime is formally on track to become a stand-alone company after shareholders approved the separation at an extraordinary general meeting of Kongsberg Gruppen. The post Kongsberg Maritime set to spin off as independent company first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK confirms Watchkeepr replacement this year
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has ruled out gifting the British Army Watchkeeper drone to Ukraine, while confirming continued spending on the retiring system and confirming a delivery date for its replacement under Project Corvus. The post UK confirms Watchkeepr replacement this year first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Sonobuoy contract for Royal Navy Merlin anti-sub force
item.description: The Royal Navy Merlin helicopter force is set to receive a major boost after the Ministry of Defence awarded a £40 million contract to Ultra Maritime to supply new sonobuoys. The post Sonobuoy contract for Royal Navy Merlin anti-sub force first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Three jailed for 75 years over drugs and firearms plots
item.description: Three men involved in large-scale drug trafficking and discussions around the acquisition and exchange of firearms have been jailed for a combined total of 75 years following a National Crime Agency investigation. The post Three jailed for 75 years over drugs and firearms plots first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Police back National Police Service plan, urge safeguards
item.description: Senior policing bodies have publicly supported the government proposal to create a National Police Service, while stressing that the reform must preserve strong links with local forces and communities. The post Police back National Police Service plan, urge safeguards first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
